questions.question: Whom does Isaiah 54 call to sing?
options: The proud and lofty city that once ruled over all of the nations
The barren one who did not bear, for her children will be many
The rich and powerful merchant whose many ships filled the sea
The mighty and conquering king who won very great victories
questions.answer: The barren one who did not bear, for her children will be many

questions.question: What covenant does God promise in Isaiah 54?
options: A covenant of war against the nations
My covenant of peace shall not be removed
A new law to replace the one of old
An oath sworn between the kings of earth
questions.answer: My covenant of peace shall not be removed

questions.question: Isaiah 54 says no weapon formed against you shall prosper.
My steadfast love shall not depart from you, and my covenant of _____ shall not be removed.
No _____ that is fashioned against you shall succeed.
